Galette 1.3.4 is out of the oven! 🥧

A batch of fixes, don't let it get cold: upgrading is recommended.

🔒 Security fixes
🔐 Two-factor authentication is no longer experimental
🐘 PHP 8.6 support
📎 Dynamic fields files removed along with their record
🐛 And a few other fixes
